City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
March 21, 2011
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificate of Congratulations to Brett Rinehart, participant in the 18th Sensyu International Citizens Marathon.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: March 7
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report approving 3-year contract with e-civis for a grants management program at $10,282 per year. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
e.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance 740, Zone Text Amendment No. 2011-01, an amendment adding Section 11.1.70.17(B)4 to the
Lomita Municipal Code to provide that the discontinuance of a legal nonconforming massage establishment use for a period of 30 consecutive days or more shall result in the loss of legal nonconforming status. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
f.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance 741, Zone Change No. 2011-01, an amendment to the City's Zoning Map from C-G, Commercial General to R-1, Single Family Residential, for the properties located at 2150 250th Street, 25017 Woodward Avenue, 25019 Woodward Avenue and 25027 Woodward Avenue. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
g.
Report recommending adoption of resolution in support of Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) business friendly principles. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
h.
Report recommending accepting easement for 25929 Avocado Street. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
i.
Report recommending approval of Amendment to Capital Reserve Agreement between LA County Metropolitan Transportation Authority and the City of Lomita for the Crenshaw/Lomita Blvd. paving project. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
SCHEDULED MATTERS
ADJOURNMENT
Adjourn to 6 pm on March 22, 2011 to discuss the Cypress Water Reservoir.
You are requested to turn off cell phones, pagers or any other electronic device. If you need to have discussion with someone in the audience, please step out to the lobby.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
COUNCILMEMBERS: Estrada, Gazeley, Suminaga, Traina and Mayor Blackwood
6.
MEETING WITH PLANNING COMMISSION Selection of a date to meet with the Planning Commission.
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
CLOSED SESSION
CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6 City designated representative: Gary Sugano
Employee organization: Lomita City Employees’ Association
